readings.title: The Infinite Divide
readings.subtitle: Identifying the Creator and the Right Arm
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:1] The words of Aḡur son of Yaqeh, a message. This man declared to Ithi’ĕl, to Ithi’ĕl and Uḵal: [2] For I am more stupid than anyone, And do not have the understanding of a man. [3] And I have not learned wisdom That I should know the knowledge of the Set-apart One. [4] Who has gone up to the heavens and come down? Who has gathered the wind in <dn>His</dn> fists? Who has bound the waters in a garment? Who established <dn>את</dn> all the ends of the earth? What is <dn>His</dn> Name, And what is <dn>His</dn> Son’s Name, If you know it?

readings.title: A Shield of Uncorrupted Truth
readings.subtitle: The Danger of Altering the Instruction
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:5] Every Word of <dn>Eloah</dn> is tried; <dn>He</dn> is a shield to those taking refuge in <dn>Him</dn>. [6] Do not add to <dn>His</dn> Words, Lest <dn>He</dn> reprove you, and you be found a liar.

readings.title: Petitioning for the Continual Bread
readings.subtitle: Maintaining Equilibrium in the Hedge
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:7] Two matters I have asked of <dn>You</dn> – Deny them not to me before I die: [8] Remove falsehood and a lying word far from me; Give me neither poverty nor riches; Feed me my lawfull bread; [9] Lest I become satisfied and deny <dn>You</dn>, And say, “Who is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>?” And lest I be poor, and steal, And seize <dn>את</dn> the Name of my <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: Avoiding Unrighteous Slander
readings.subtitle: The Consequence of Baseless Accusation
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:10] Do not slander a servant to his master, Lest he curse you, And you be found guilty.

readings.title: Four Generations of Systemic Corruption
readings.subtitle: Devouring the Poor and Needy
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:11] There is a generation that curses its father, And does not bless its mother – [12] There is a generation, clean in its own eyes, But not washed from its own filth. [13] There is a generation; Oh, how haughty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up. [14] There is a generation whose teeth are swords, And whose jaw-teeth are knives, To devour the poor from off the earth, And the needy from among men.

readings.title: Systems Lacking Restitution
readings.subtitle: The Parasitic Nature of Rebellion
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:15] The leech has two daughters: “Give! Give!” Three are not satisfied, Four that never say, “Enough”: [16] She’ol, and the barren womb, Soil not satisfied with water, And fire which never says, “Enough.”

readings.title: The Consequence of Scorn
readings.subtitle: The Biological Cleanup of the Rebellious
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:17] An eye that mocks his father, And scorns to obey his mother – Ravens of the wadi dig <dn>את</dn> it out, And young eagles eat it!

readings.title: The Hidden Physics of the Earth
readings.subtitle: Tracing the Unseen and the Unrighteous
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:18] Three matters are too marvellous for me, And four which I do not understand: [19] The way of an eagle in the heavens, The way of a snake on a rock, The way of a ship in the heart of the sea, And the way of a man with a young woman. [20] This is the way of an adulterous woman: She shall eat and wipe her mouth, and say, “I have not done wickedness.”

readings.title: Disruptions to the Appointed Order
readings.subtitle: The Inversion of Valid Hierarchy
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:21] Under three matters the earth trembles, And under four, it is unable to bear: [22] Under a servant when he reigns, And a fool when he is satisfied with food, [23] Under a hated woman who marries, And a female servant who supplants her mistress.

readings.title: Small but Structurally Sound
readings.subtitle: Strict Behavioral Models for Operation
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:24] There are four matters Which are little on the earth, But they are exceedingly wise: [25] The ants are a people not strong, Yet they prepare their food in the summer; [26] The rock badgers are a weak folk, Yet they make their homes in the crags; [27] The locusts have no sovereign, Yet they all go out in formation; [28] A spider takes hold with two hands, And is in sovereigns’ palaces.

readings.title: Models of Undeterred Leadership
readings.subtitle: The Anatomy of Authority
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:29] There are three matters That are going well, And four are good in walking: [30] A lion, which is mighty among beasts And does not turn away from facing all; [31] A greyhound, and a male goat, And a sovereign whose army is with him.

readings.title: Suppressing the Agents of Strife
readings.subtitle: Halting the Mechanics of Wrath
readings.text: [Proverbs 30:32] If you have been foolish in lifting up yourself, Or if you have plotted evil, Put your hand on your mouth. [33] For as milk under pressure brings forth curds, And as a nose under pressure brings forth blood, So wrath under pressure brings forth strife.

readings.title: Preserving the Strength of the Leader
readings.subtitle: The Compromise of Distraction
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:1] The words of Sovereign Lemu’ĕl, a message which his mother taught him: [2] What, my chosen? And what, chosen of my womb? And what, chosen of my vows? [3] Do not give your strength to women, Nor your ways to wiping away sovereigns.

readings.title: The Proper Administration of Resources
readings.subtitle: Alleviating the Burden of the Afflicted
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:4] Not for sovereigns, O Lemu’ĕl, Not for sovereigns to drink wine, Nor for princes to desire strong drink; [5] Lest they drink and forget what is inscribed, And pervert the right of all the afflicted. [6] Give strong drink to him who is perishing, And wine to those embittered in being. [7] Let him drink and forget his poverty, And remember his trouble no more.

readings.title: The Premial Mandate for the Vulnerable
readings.subtitle: Acting as the Righteous Covering
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:8] Open your mouth for the dumb, In the cause of all the sons of the departed. [9] Open your mouth, judge righteously, And plead the cause of the poor and needy.

readings.section: The Blueprint of the Ezer Kenegdo
readings.title: A Foundation of Absolute Trust
readings.subtitle: The True Measure of Value
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:10] Who does find a capable wife? For she is worth far more than rubies. [11] The heart of her husband shall trust her, And he has no lack of gain. [12] She shall do him good, and not evil, All the days of her life.

readings.section: The Blueprint of the Ezer Kenegdo
readings.title: Generating the Reserved Increase
readings.subtitle: A Model of Unceasing Industry
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:13] She shall seek wool and flax, And with delight she works with her hands. [14] She shall be as the ships of Tarshish, She brings in her food from afar. [15] She also rises while it is still night, And provides food for her household, And what is lawfull for her girls. [16] She shall consider a field and buy it; From her profits she shall plant a vineyard. [17] She shall gird herself with strength, And strengthen her arms. [18] She shall taste when her gain is good; Her lamp does not go out by night. [19] She shall stretch out her hands to the distaff, And her hand shall hold the spindle.

readings.section: The Blueprint of the Ezer Kenegdo
readings.title: Equipping the Household for Adversity
readings.subtitle: Establishing the Hedge of Provision
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:20] She shall extend her hand to the poor, And she shall reach out her hands to the needy. [21] She is not afraid of snow for her household, For all her household is dressed in scarlet. [22] She shall make tapestry for herself; She is dressed in fine linen and purple. [23] Her husband is known in the gates, When he sits among the elders of the land. [24] She shall make fine linen and sell them, And shall give girdles for the merchants.

readings.section: The Blueprint of the Ezer Kenegdo
readings.title: The Torah of Loving-Commitment
readings.subtitle: Rejecting the Friction of Idleness
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:25] Strength and splendour are her garments, And she rejoices in time to come. [26] She shall open <dn>את</dn> her mouth with wisdom, And on her tongue is the Torah of loving-commitment. [27] She watches over <dn>את</dn> the ways of her household, And does not eat the bread of idleness.

readings.section: The Blueprint of the Ezer Kenegdo
readings.title: The Public Vindication of the Righteous
readings.subtitle: Yielding the Fruit of Substantive Action
readings.text: [Proverbs 31:28] Her children shall rise up and call her blessed; Her husband too, and he praises her: [29] “Many daughters have done nobly, But you have risen over them all.” [30] Loveliness is deceptive And prettiness is vain, A woman who fears <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is to be praised. [31] Give her <dn>את</dn> of the fruit of her hands, And let her works praise her in the gates.
